notes: Classes of action that must be approved by a human before the suite performs them. Approval ids are issued and recorded by tools-audio-approvals.py; the suite refuses the action without a matching, unexpired, unused grant.

actions.label: Overwrite an existing audio file
actions.when: Any processing run whose output path already exists

actions.label: Delete or replace master or source audio
actions.when: Any removal of source, master, or approved deliverable files

actions.label: Publish, deliver, or mark a deliverable final
actions.when: Building a signed delivery package or transferring it to a recipient
actions.approver: producer plus rights holder where applicable

actions.label: Confirm rights and consent clearance
actions.when: Declaring music, sample, voice, or likeness rights cleared

actions.label: Use a real person's voice or likeness
actions.when: Any synthetic speech, voice conversion, or imitation of an identifiable person
actions.approver: the person concerned or their authorised representative

actions.label: Run a batch over many files
actions.when: A batch job that writes more than 10 output files or rewrites existing ones

actions.label: Apply irreversible restoration to an original
actions.when: Spectral repair, destructive cleanup, or resampling of a sole master copy
